thread:
Maya K: quick async standup for surge prep — what I did: added eviction-rate alert to the autoscaler dashboard, ran a test drain on ams-spot to validate graceful drain (succeeded), and updated the prewarm sheet with new warmup targets.

Maya K: blockers: Cloud support still hasn't approved the GPU vCPU quota bump for eu-west-1 (ticket #4521). without that we can't open the extra dedicated pool for the weekend. :grimacing:

Liam: noted. I'll escalate the quota ticket now, pinging our account rep. Can you paste the support link?

Maya K: support.redwoodcloud.com/tickets/4521 — escalated to priority-2 yesterday. added the exact numbers in the ticket (need +48 GPUs, ephemeral pool for 36h).

Cheng: FYI I reviewed the autoscaler PR — small comment: lower the cool-down to 45s for scale-down path so we don't oscillate during short spot blips. left an inline on the PR. :eyes:

Maya K: thanks — will update. also ran a short canary routing test to route 10% traffic to us-west1 fallback; latency +12ms but stable.

Rachel: ops ask — when you drain ams-spot next time, can you add a label so the billing team can filter usage? label format: billing:surge-weekend.

Maya K: yep will do. sample drain command I used:

```
# drain pool with 2m grace for KV cache flush
rctl drain --pool ams-spot --grace 120 --label billing:surge-weekend
```

Liam: quick heads-up — noticed increased spot evictions around 03:00 UTC in the last 48h, looks like cloud maintenance window. If quota isn't approved we should pre-schedule model warmup to avoid cold starts.

Cheng: agree. I'll add a warmup job that kicks off 30m before the surge window and pins small footprint replicas. probably a short-lived deployment: image warmup:v1 -> run 3x token-gen calls.

Maya K: blocker for me: need a quick CR review on the autoscaler change (PR #6782) — specifically the fallback routing toggle. if no objections I'll merge tonight and push a canary.

Liam: I'll review in 30m. if opsbot shows no failures we can roll the canary. :thumbsup:

opsbot: deploy-candidate autoscaler/6782 passed e2e smoke (0 failures).

InfraBot: note — if quota request fails, fallback plan is to throttle non-prod to 20% and shift prod to us-west1. I've added the action to the ops runbook (runbook/surge-fallback).

Rachel: thanks team. I'll follow up with billing after the drain label goes out.

Maya K: plan for today: (1) escalate quota, (2) apply Cheng's cooldown tweak and merge after Liam's review, (3) schedule warmup job if quota still pending. ping me here for any quick unblock.

Liam: ack.

Cheng: ack.

Rachel: ack. :white_check_mark:
